visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair, wearing a white lab coat with a name tag, sits in front of a golden anatomical human model and beige curtains, greeting the viewer with a friendly smile and animated hand gestures. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top and jeans, enters the frame from the left, pointing to a dark gray smudge on her forehead and a yellowish skin tone. (3) The doctor-character hands the woman a four-color makeup palette; she looks surprised and then holds the product up, pointing to her face which now appears clear and glowing. (4) Another woman with bangs and a chunky white knit sweater enters, pointing to large purple-hued dark circles under her eyes with a distressed expression. (5) The doctor hands her a different makeup palette; she applies it and then smiles at the camera with clear under-eyes. (6) A young man with short hair and red spots on his cheeks appears; the doctor presents a green-toned palette, and the man's skin appears neutralized and clear in the next frame. (7) An individual wearing an elaborate black feathered coat, a gold metallic dress, and beaded braids enters; the doctor reacts with a shocked face and then playfully hits the individual with a large black inflatable toy hammer labeled '1000'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright electronic synth music with a driving beat begins. A confident male voice greets the listener with high pitch variability and a cheerful tone. (2) A quick 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as a female voice with high arousal and a distressed, high-pitched tone complains about her skin condition. (3) A bright 'ding' bell SFX highlights the presentation of the makeup product. The male voice continues with authoritative but friendly professional narration over the constant beat. (4) Another female voice speaks rapidly with a frantic, stressed tone. A 'sparkle' chime sound effect accompanies the visual reveal of her corrected skin. (5) A rhythmic transition sound leads into the male speaker explaining the third product's use. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and energy. (6) A dramatic orchestral stinger SFX plays for the entry of a new theatrical voice speaking slowly and confidently. (7) Two distinct hollow 'thud' or rubbery impact sounds occur, synced with the visual of the toy hammer hitting the person. A final playful chime jingle ends the sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Introduction -> Product Solution -> Humorous Climax -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the KAIBEAUTY concealer palettes by using a humorous 'clinic' metaphor where makeup products are prescribed as medicine for common skin concerns.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is centered around showcasing the features and names of KAIBEAUTY makeup palettes, with the main creator acting as the brand's spokesperson.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends professional beauty advice with variety-show-style comedy to maintain high viewer engagement while delivering product information.
